title: Read-only chain file is attributed to git 2.56 but git 2.43.0 writes it read-only too
evidence: git 2.43.0: 'git commit-graph write --reachable --split' creates commit-graph-chain with mode -r--r--r--. As uid 0 the 3f486562 fixture passes; with CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE dropped it fails with PermissionError on commit-graph-chain; the bb1f0971 fixture passes in both conditions.
consequence: The stated cause is inexact; a reader may think root runs on old git are a different case. No effect on any control.
reproduction: setpriv --bounding-set=-dac_override,-dac_read_search,-fowner --inh-caps=-all python -m unittest tests.test_legal_audit_auth_ledger.ReviewFixes03.test_r01_forged_commit_graph_single_and_split, with the test file of 3f486562 and of bb1f0971
required_correction: Optional: reword the comment to 'git writes it read-only; a non-root runner cannot overwrite it'.

title: Review-boundary statement does not cover the later test change in bb1f0971
evidence: The bullet says the commit that adds the file changes documentation only and 'No code, test or data changed'. True for aa77a305. bb1f0971 then changes tests/test_legal_audit_auth_ledger.py (+4 -1). No review record in the package covers bb1f0971.
consequence: A reader of the package at the merge candidate may take the whole post-review difference to be documentation only.
required_correction: Next round: add one line naming bb1f0971 as a test-fixture-only change after the reviewed head, or record this review.

title: Symlink advice names only the package directory
evidence: The auditor is told to check that legal_knowledge/audit_work/AUTH-LEDGER is a real directory. C-02 rests on path resolution; a symlink at legal_knowledge or legal_knowledge/audit_work would resolve the same way. Not tested in this review.
consequence: The manual check as worded may miss a symlinked parent. Still inside the stated trust assumption (fresh clone).
required_correction: Optional: say 'no component of the path is a symlink'; cover it in the C-02 code check.

title: Fixture does not assert that plain git honours the forged graph
evidence: On git 2.43.0 plain git reports 2 parents for both forms (measured). The test asserts only that the tool reports 1 parent. A git that ignored the forged graph would give the same result. git 2.56 was not available.
consequence: On an untested git version the test could pass without exercising the vector.
reproduction: python c8fin/vec.py from a copy of the repository
required_correction: Optional: assert in the fixture that 'git rev-list --parents -n 1 <c2>' without the option shows two parents, or skip with a stated reason.

consequence: None now; it is worded as a candidate.
